objections.claim: The clean-room acceptance requires a plugin-subtree-only copy, with no repository parent or escaping reads, to run gate + audit + verify green. The same section requires a protected external git commit anchor and resolves every authoritative blob through `git cat-file`; without an external object database it must return `anchor-unavailable`. Creating an anchor from the copied subtree would let the tree writer choose the trust root and defeat the stated out-of-tree security property. The approach must supply an independently authenticated object store/trust bundle to this test or require the authority gate to deny while testing self-containment separately.

The release trust-anchor mechanism is internally contradictory. E2 defines the release anchor as a signed annotated tag target whose signature is checked against an out-of-tree fingerprint, while the release design explicitly requires the tag not to exist during gate/build, supersedes annotated signed tags with an Ed25519 release-acceptance block, and removes RELEASE_SIGNER_FINGERPRINT. Consequently authoritative release verification has no anchor satisfying E2 as written. The approach must consistently define the accepted draft target plus Eye signature as the external anchor, including its git-object resolution mechanism, or retain the signed-tag design.
